Game Overview

In Stack Jump Ball, the core idea is straightforward: guide a bouncing ball through mesmerizing rotating platforms. Break through safe layers, dodge perilous colors, and rack up points as you speed down. With captivating visuals and intuitive controls, each round promises a heart-pounding blend of strategy and reflexes, perfect for a fun, fast gaming escape.
